definitions.baseline: Exact published stage1 source cb35f481; retained gzip defaults to docs/validation/baselines/stage1-football-sim.js.gz.
definitions.safeHelper: Existing pass option at actual reception: normal pass, risk<.35, arrivalRisk<.65, receiver space>2.4 and teammate is in current support plan. A read is not an executed or completed pass.
definitions.flightTargets: Commanded destinations; actual helper distances at reception are recorded separately.
definitions.limits: Small synthetic sample, no hidden opponent orders/RNG forcing, scores are actual event goals. Natural branches share complete stage1 state then diverge normally.
